proposals.title: Separate embryo effects from sampling and refit variability
proposals.claim: An uncertainty report indexed by biological target embryo prevents repeated sampling seeds from being counted as independent biological evidence.
proposals.mechanism: Record paired model differences for mmd_u within each target embryo; separate cell-sampling and refit seed ranges from between-embryo uncertainty. Replace first-row diagnostic selection with prespecified whole-cloud paired sampling once eligible data exist.
proposals.falsifier: Audit the report schema on synthetic metadata: reject the design if five seeds from one embryo yield n=5 biological replicates or a population confidence interval.

evidence.says: Diagnostic scorer caps at 150 and selects contiguous first rows for predictions, truth and coordinates.

evidence.ref: Zimmerman et al., Nature Communications 2021, doi:10.1038/s41467-021-21038-1, https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-21038-1
evidence.says: Cells within an individual are dependent subsamples; individual-level variation is required for population inference.

proposals.title: Freeze a primary contrast and distinguish critique from experiment
proposals.claim: A frozen tuning and endpoint ledger distinguishes held-out empirical validation from selection on that target and from expert acceptance.
proposals.mechanism: Prespecify combined-versus-composition mmd_u improvement and margins for de_direction, variogram and neighborhood_mmd guardrails. Record all official components; store critic status separately from measured outcomes and uncertainty.
proposals.falsifier: Reject the ledger if changing a model after reading outer-target metrics preserves its test status, or critic acceptance alone sets an empirical-supported flag.

evidence.says: Verdict statuses set supported/falsified lifecycle and contribute binary sustained counts to calibration without experiments.
Optimizing finite-sample selection criteria can cause overfitting and biased subsequent performance evaluation.

peer_responses.on: benchdesign-r1-1: whole-cloud measurement contract and same-split comparisons
peer_responses.because: First-row slices at Neurl IPS 2026/agent_orchestrator.py:175–185 motivate the contract. Treat seeds as conditional variability; require target-embryo and litter/batch identifiers before population uncertainty.

peer_responses.on: benchdesign-r1-2: independent residual selection and matched controls
peer_responses.because: Freeze primary margin and secondary loss tolerances before assessment. Target residual selection consumes that holdout; no independent test remains without fresh eligible data. Power against a positive threshold depends on anticipated effect minus threshold.

declined: Increase seeds until every bootstrap comparison wins: seeds characterize conditional numerical variability and cannot repair embryo-stage confounding, selection bias or absent biological replication.
